map.📚 深度解析：虫咬(皮炎)反应评分器: 📚 Deep Dive: Insect Bite (Dermatitis) Reaction Scorer
map.反应评分：录入叮咬处红斑直径、是否水肿/水疱、瘙痒程度，工具按轻/中/重给出反应: Reaction scoring: enter the erythema diameter at the bite, whether edema/vesicles are present, and itch degree; the tool gives mild/moderate/severe grading and management points.
map.鉴别提示：对大疱、环形红斑或条索状分布（如隐翅虫）标注特殊形态，提示避免误判为普: Differentiation cue: flag large bullae, annular erythema, or linear distribution (e.g., Paederus) as special morphology to avoid misjudging as a common mosquito bite.
map.全身预警：若伴发热、淋巴结肿大或广泛风团，提示过敏/系统反应可能，建议就医而非仅: Systemic warning: if accompanied by fever, lymphadenopathy, or widespread wheals, it suggests possible allergy/systemic reaction; advise consultation rather than local care only.
map.示例：小腿一处 3cm 红斑、轻度水肿、瘙痒 2/10 无水疱 → 评为轻度虫咬: Example: one 3 cm erythema on the lower leg, mild edema, itch 2/10, no vesicles → rated mild insect-bite dermatitis; advises cold compress, topical calamine / low-potency steroid, and observation.
map.虫咬局部红肿常见，但若迅速扩大、起大疱或伴发热、呼吸困难，可能是过敏或感染，应及: Local redness and swelling after a bite are common, but if it rapidly expands, develops bullae, or is accompanied by fever or dyspnea, it may be allergy or infection and needs timely care.
